tool_args.rationale: The five paid observations vary only u_now and are consistent with a saturating response, but the recalled bridge and flux-conservation signatures leave a genuine mechanism ambiguity. An open-branch probe directly tests that distinction before fitting a predictive law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supplied rows with a smooth stationary response in u_now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows share the same horizon and other state inputs, so this cannot resolve whether the bridge/flux mechanism changes on the open branch.
A more detailed trajectory is less targeted than the available branch-discriminating measurement.
It is not relevant to the target law and is explicitly not worth purchasing.
